newsitem.title: USA: AMRESCO to offer $100 mln snr sub notes.
newsitem.headline: AMRESCO to offer $100 mln snr sub notes.

text.p: AMRESCO Inc said Friday that it has filed a preliminary prospectus with the SEC to offer $100 million of senior subordinated notes, series 1997-A, due 2004.
The offering is being made pursuant to a $250 million shelf registration statement, which registered $250 million of AMRESCO debt and securities.

The notes will not be secured and will not be redeemable prior to maturity. The proceeds will be used to reduce outstanding bank borrowings and the company said that the aggregate amount of the offer may be increased prior to pricing.
The company also said Friday that it is in negotiations to acquire a privately-held business finance company, but that a definitive agreement has not been reached.
AMRESCO is a diversified financial services company involved in the commercial and residential real estate industry, as well as commercial lending.
